Kim Kardashian reveals esophagitis diagnosis, links to father's death

Reality television personality Kim Kardashian has revealed a new health scare, disclosing a diagnosis of esophagitis. The condition has prompted her to reflect on her father's death from esophageal cancer. Kardashian shared this information during a recent public appearance, drawing a connection between her own health issue and her father's past illness. The news has also led to public interest in understanding the condition of esophagitis.
